1.explanation:
• src/js/components/DataFilters/README.md – describes the DataFilters API and current `drop` prop behavior.
• src/js/components/DataFilters/index.js – contains the component implementation where the new `layer` prop would integrate (switching between Drop and Layer).
• src/js/components/DataFilters/stories – shows real usage examples of DataFilters in storybook, illustrating the overflow in the dropdown.
• src/js/components/Drop/README.md – documents the Drop component used under the hood for `drop`, to understand its sizing and scroll behavior.
• src/js/components/DropButton/README.md – explains how DropButton triggers the Drop and its styling considerations.
• src/js/components/Layer/README.md – details the Layer component that should be used to render filters in a separate overlay, as per the expected behavior.
1.bug_scenario: The issue occurs in the DataFilters component when the user clicks the filter icon to open the filter menu. With many filter fields (checkbox groups for Role, Status, Location, Name, plus a RangeSelector for hours available), the dropdown (Drop) container is too small and introduces its own scrollbar, causing the filter list to overflow and be awkward to navigate. In contrast, the expected behavior is to render the filters in a separate fullscreen (or large) layer (Layer) so that all filter controls are fully visible without internal scrolling.
